primary_link.title: Context-Based Adversarial Attacks on AI Code Generators: Vulnerability Analysis and Implications

papers.summary: AI-powered code generation systems have transformed software development but introduce critical inference-time security vulnerabilities. primary_link.title: Beyond Uniform Token-Level Trust Region in LLM Reinforcement Learning

top5.summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has become standard for improving LLM reasoning. However, existing PPO-style trust-region mechanisms remain position-agnostic by enforcing uniform thresholds across all tokens independently. This pointwise treatment conflicts with autoregressive generation in two critical ways. First, uniform thresholds ignore autoregressive asymmetry. Early-stage deviations produce compounding sequence-level drift, causing static thresholds to under-regulate
top5.summary_zh: 強化學習搭配可驗證獎勵（RLVR）已成為提升 LLM 推理能力的標準方法，但現有 PPO 風格的信賴域機制對所有 token 施加統一約束，忽略自回歸生成中早期 token 偏差會累積放大、後期 token 則可能過度限制的問題。本文指出此「位置無感」策略會導致要麼早期欠約束造成序列漂移，要麼後期過約束削弱探索。為此提出超越均一 token 級信賴域的新方法，依據 token 在序列中的位置動態調整約束強度，以更精細地平衡策略更新與生成穩定性。此研究有助於提升 RLVR 訓練的推理模型品質與收斂效率。
